name: Oumi Sorane
source:
[spoiler]Her real identity is a rabbit that have been saved from death by princess from Inaba. But she receives 2 curse and a blessing after saved the princess later. Her first curse is transformation curse, when she become human she is a rabbit within it and when she become rabbit she is a human within it. The second curse is perennial youth. But her blessing make her curse become more confusing, her blessing is transformation combination. It make her become a human with rabbit ear, half human and half rabbit, nekomata rabbit type (said Reiji). After Gen update her blessing to make she can transform freely, she can hide her rabbit ear. Actually Gen can remove her curse but it only give her consecutive death after receive perennial youth.

In her route, she repeating resurrection cycle, die at the night and birth at the morning. This cycle occur when she fall in love with Ichito. At first she only feel sick but later her sick become death and then birth at the morning. This resurrection cycle will occur everyday until she meet her real death where her lifespan become empty.[/spoiler]
